lines.en: Priya, look at that old house on the corner. It’s said that it is haunted.
lines.pt: Priya, olhe aquela casa velha na esquina. Dizem que ela é mal-assombrada.

lines.en: I’ve heard that too. It’s believed that a sailor died there in the 1800s.
lines.pt: Também ouvi isso. Acredita-se que um marinheiro morreu ali nos anos 1800.

lines.en: Some neighbours say that lights are seen in the windows at night. It’s claimed that nobody lives there.
lines.pt: Alguns vizinhos dizem que se veem luzes nas janelas à noite. Afirma-se que ninguém mora lá.

lines.en: It’s thought that the owner left the country many years ago, and that nobody ever bought the building.
lines.pt: Pensa-se que o dono deixou o país há muitos anos, e que ninguém nunca comprou o prédio.

lines.en: Honestly, I don’t believe it. It’s known that old wooden houses make strange noises in the wind.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, eu não acredito. Sabe-se que casas velhas de madeira fazem barulhos estranhos com o vento.

lines.en: You may be right, but it’s reported that a tourist ran out of there screaming last year.
lines.pt: Você pode ter razão, mas foi relatado que um turista saiu correndo de lá gritando no ano passado.

lines.en: That could be just a rumour. It’s often said that stories like this attract visitors.
lines.pt: Isso pode ser só um boato. Costuma-se dizer que histórias assim atraem visitantes.

lines.en: Maybe. It’s even rumoured that the council wants to turn it into a museum next year.
lines.pt: Talvez. Até se diz que a prefeitura quer transformá-la em museu no ano que vem.

lines.en: In that case, it’s expected that the ghost will become a famous guide, isn’t it?
lines.pt: Nesse caso, espera-se que o fantasma vire um guia famoso, não é?

lines.en: Ha! It’s understood that tickets will cost twenty dollars, but nothing is guaranteed yet.
lines.pt: Ha! Entende-se que os ingressos custarão vinte dólares, mas nada está garantido ainda.

lines.en: Well, I will visit it once, but I will not go inside alone after dark.
lines.pt: Bem, vou visitá-la uma vez, mas não entro lá sozinho depois de escurecer.

compare.ask: It’s said that it is haunted.
compare.br: Em português, dizemos “dizem que” ou “acredita-se que”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It’s said that it is haunted.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use it is said / believed / thought that + frase.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: It’s said that it is haunted.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

facts.big: it is said / believed / thought that…
facts.label: Passivo de relato
facts.sub: Use it is + particípio + that para relatar o que se diz: it is said, believed, thought, known, claimed, reported, expected. Depois de that vem uma frase completa.

facts.label: Dizem que…
facts.sub: Use it is said that + frase para repetir o que as pessoas dizem sem dizer quem: It’s said that the house is haunted. Em português: “Dizem que…”. Comum em histórias e notícias.

facts.label: Outros verbos
facts.sub: Troque said por outro particípio: believed (acredita-se), thought (pensa-se), known (sabe-se), claimed (afirma-se), reported (relata-se), expected (espera-se). A estrutura continua igual.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “It’s said that…” reports what people say.
We say “It say that the house is old”.
“It’s believed that…” shows that people think so.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “It’s said that…” reports what people say. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It say that the house is old”. → Falso (We say It’s said that…)
“It’s believed that…” shows that people think so. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: The house on the corner · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold evening in Auckland, and the wind is strong. Cal and Marco walk home along a dark street. On the corner stands an old wooden house. Its windows are broken, and its garden is wild. Everybody in the area has a story about it. The two friends stop to look at it.

“Marco, look at that old house on the corner. It’s said that it is haunted.” says Cal. “I’ve heard that too. It’s believed that a sailor died there in the 1800s.” says Marco. “Some neighbours say that lights are seen in the windows at night. It’s claimed that nobody lives there.” says Cal.
